Phase 2 ratchet-up: token expansion added ~586B compressed shell CSS. Every ceiling grew by the same ~586B; the per-route HTML fraction did not change. Recorded here rather than silently absorbed because Phase 3 owns the shrink.

Phase 3 slice 2 ratchet-up: overflow-x mask removed from body; per-element scroll containment added for pre + table with keyboard-reachable tabindex hydration when the region actually overflows. Every ceiling grew by ~118B (CSS + JS). Installation route at 296,131B with ~3.9KB headroom; 56 non-grandfathered routes remain under the 300000 hard cap.

Phase 3 slice 4 ratchet-up: empty-TOC no longer renders as an empty <aside>/<details>; section-aware breadcrumb adds one crumb for non-meta pages; previous-edition notice renders on 1.0.0 routes with a copper indicator bar. Every ceiling grew by ~107-223B (slight variance because breadcrumb section crumb only appears on non-meta pages). rationale: Extends apps/docs/scripts/verify-static-budget.mjs from the single installation route to every enumerable docs route. Ten routes currently exceed the frozen 300000 byte cap for docs-total-transfer-compressed because the enforcement point was previously the installation route alone. Each over-cap route is grandfathered at its measured value; every future build must be strictly non-worsening against its ceiling, and every non-grandfathered route must respect the 300000 byte cap. jitterToleranceBytes (64) is applied ONLY to grandfathered ceilings to absorb Next.js build-id/chunk-hash non-determinism (observed drift up to ±2 bytes across clean rebuilds of an identical source tree); the frozen 300000 byte cap has ~4-6KB headroom on non-grandfathered routes so it is enforced strictly with zero tolerance. Phase 2 (2026-08-17) token expansion legitimately grew every ceiling by ~586B compressed as the new state/content/layout tokens landed on the shared shell CSS — this is a recorded ratchet-up as the shell grew, not a silent regression. Phase 3 exit criterion, per docs/decisions/docs-performance-baselines.md: every grandfathered ceiling equals capUnderRatchet (i.e. every over-cap route has been shrunk to 300000 or below) before Phase 3 marks complete. Phase 3 must recover both the pre-Phase-2 gap (4-13KB) and the Phase-2 shell-CSS growth (~586B). Cap widening is a separate explicit user decision that must land in performance-budgets.json first.
